test_overview: Evaluated the ComfortPro Connect HVAC booking app against the 3-step reschedule test plan. Step 1: Client Riley Carter signed up (auto-login worked) and created Booking #1 (HVAC/Residential/Maintenance/Standard, 233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago IL 60606, preferred date today+14 = Aug 22 2026, PM window). Confirmation view displayed Booking ID #1 and the booking appeared in the client's list — all verifications including non-fatal ones passed (8/8). Step 2: Technician Ava Bennett signed up in a separate context, found Booking #1, converted it to Job #1 with schedule Aug 22 PM — Job created in Scheduled status with scheduled date/time and technician name displayed correctly. Rescheduled via the Reschedule Job modal to Aug 25 (today+17) with Specific Time 09:30 — accepted, displayed 'Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM' with success toast, status remained Scheduled, and the new schedule persisted (verified via navigate-away-and-back after the SPA reload reset; jobs list post-reload and reopened detail both showed the persisted value) — all verifications including non-fatal ones passed (17/17). Step 3: Client session in context_A was still active; 'My Jobs' showed Job #1 with the updated schedule; opening the job detail showed Status Scheduled, 'Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM', Technician Ava Bennett, and no reschedule/edit control whatsoever for the Client (button-reschedule count = 0), satisfying the read-only criterion via the acceptable 'no control' option (10/10). Total: 35/35.

steps.description: test_client_creates_booking: Signed up as Client Riley Carter in context_A, auto-signed in. Created booking with all specified fields (HVAC, Residential, Maintenance, Standard, 7735550191, 233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL, 60606, preferred 2026-08-22 PM, 'Annual tune-up.'). Submission landed on 'Service Request Submitted!' confirmation showing Booking ID #1 and matching details (BOOKING_ID=1 recorded). Booking #1 appeared in the Client's 'My Service Bookings' list. All fatal and non-fatal verifications passed.

test_technician_converts_and_reschedules: Signed up as Technician Ava Bennett in context_B, auto-signed in, located Booking #1 in 'All Service Bookings'. Converted to Job via modal (date 2026-08-22, PM): Job #1 created with status Scheduled, 'Aug 22, 2026 at PM' schedule, and Ava Bennett displayed as Technician. Rescheduled via 'Reschedule Job' button: set date 2026-08-25 and Specific Time 09:30. Change accepted ('Job rescheduled to Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM' toast), detail showed 'Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM', status remained Scheduled. Persistence confirmed: after a page reload the SPA reset to the bookings list, but the Jobs list and reopened Job #1 detail both showed the persisted 'Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM' (navigate-away-and-back alternative per plan). All fatal and non-fatal verifications passed.

test_client_views_updated_schedule_readonly: Returned to context_A; Riley Carter still signed in. 'My Jobs' list showed Job #1 with updated schedule 'Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM'. Job detail displayed Status: Scheduled, Scheduled: Aug 25, 2026 at 9:30 AM, Technician: Ava Bennett. Read-only verified: no reschedule/edit control exists for the Client (button-reschedule count = 0, no status select, no edit controls), satisfying the acceptable criterion 'there is no reschedule/edit control for the Client'; no edit attempt required.
